results.message: What was the hardest part of building it?
results.text:
The hardest part was making it feel both **useful and trustworthy**.

A static resume is easy to generate, but I wanted JustinGPT to answer follow-up questions well without drifting into made-up details. So the tricky bits were:

- building the **two-step pipeline** so questions get routed correctly first
- keeping answers grounded with the right context
- layering in **prompt-injection defenses** like preflight heuristics, nonce-tagged delimiters, a canary token, and least-context selection
- iterating with **evals** so I could actually measure whether the prompts were improving

That project was basically me trying to make an AI version of a resume that doesn’t hallucinate like it had three coffees too many.
